outlook.statement: Priorities remain clear: expanding market reach, strengthening manufacturing capabilities, broadening product portfolio, improving operational efficiency and building a trusted and enduring brand. Will continue to pursue growth with discipline, keeping long-term value creation at the heart of decisions.
The Directors are continuously looking for the new avenues for future growth of the Company and expect more growth in the future period.

The Indian household furnishings industry is expected to maintain a positive growth trajectory, supported by rising disposable incomes, increasing urbanization, changing consumer preferences and greater emphasis on home aesthetics, comfort and functionality. Going forward, the Company intends to strengthen its market position by expanding its product portfolio, introducing innovative and contemporary designs, improving product quality and enhancing customer experience.
